description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv6, which validates IPv6 addresses in a URI context. It extends from HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv4 and contains methods to perform validation checks, including prefix, IPv4-compatibility, and compression handling.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv6
classes.description: A class responsible for validating IPv6 address strings within URI attributes, supporting compression and IPv4 compatibility checks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an IPv6 address string, supporting prefix notation, IPv4 compatibility, and compression shorthand, returning the original string if valid or false otherwise.
